page_title: INT 2-1 SAS | Inter v Sassuolo 21/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+5' Nicholas Pierini (Sassuolo) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.

90+3' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom right corner, but Josep Martinez thwarts him with a great two-handed save.

90+2' Petar Sucic (Inter) brings his opponent down. Livio Marinelli has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Sassuolo, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
90+2' The referee allows time for a substitution. Woyo Coulibaly will be replaced by Nicholas Pierini (Sassuolo).
90+1' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Arijanet Muric intercepts the ball.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Celebrations are cut short for Inter as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
87' The Inter players joy may have been justified, because referee Livio Marinelli is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
86' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Davide Frattesi (Inter) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
84' 2 - 1 Goal! Domenico Berardi tees up Walid Cheddira (Sassuolo) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom right corner. 2:1.
81' 2 - 0 It's an own goal! Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo) scores into his own net!
81' Federico Dimarco (Inter) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
80' Luis Henrique (Inter) is free in the box and Davide Frattesi finds him with a pass, but his powerful shot skims just past the right post. Good chance!
78' Fabio Grosso prepares a substitution. Andrea Pinamonti is replaced by Walid Cheddira (Sassuolo).
77' The substitution has been made. Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) has replaced Francesco Pio Esposito.

77' Carlos Augusto (Inter) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the left side of the goal. However, Arijanet Muric anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
76' Davide Frattesi (Inter) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the bottom right corner. Arijanet Muric is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
74' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
71' 13:5 – the total goal attempt statistics. The shots on goal statistics – 3:3.
69' Aster Vranckx goes off the pitch and Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) comes on.
68' Fabio Grosso has decided to make a change. Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) replaces Armand Lauriente.
68' That will be all from Ismael Kone who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo).

67' Unbelievable! Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) wastes a huge scoring opportunity! He finds himself unmarked right in front of goal and fires in a first-time shot. Arijanet Muric pulls off one of the best saves of his career and stops the effort from hitting the net.
65' Substitution. Hakan Calhanoglu makes his way off the pitch and Davide Frattesi (Inter) comes on as his replacement.
65' Cristian Chivu has decided to substitute Denzel Dumfries and he is replaced by Luis Henrique (Inter).
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Lautaro Martinez (Inter) will replace Marcus Thuram.
63' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

62' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the top left corner. Josep Martinez shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net. Sassuolo force a corner. They send men into the box.
61' Petar Sucic does a good job setting up Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) on the edge of the box, but his nice effort curls just over the bar.
58' Federico Dimarco (Inter) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
58' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
57' Marcus Thuram (Inter) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
57' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
56' Jay Idzes (Sassuolo) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Livio Marinelli blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Inter.
55' Nicolo Barella (Inter) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Arijanet Muric, who smothers the ball.

52' Josep Martinez makes a brilliant save! Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His low shot goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
51' Marcus Thuram (Inter) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player.
51' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the corner but it's cleared.
50' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
48' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Arijanet Muric has no trouble gathering it.

48' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger. Inter will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
46' Nicolo Barella (Inter) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Arijanet Muric makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
46' Referee Livio Marinelli blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Petar Sucic (Inter) is penalised for a foul. Livio Marinelli had a clear view and blows his whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' The resulting corner, taken by Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo), comes to nothing.

44' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. The ball is out of play and Sassuolo manage to earn a corner.
42' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
42' Carlos Augusto (Inter) commits a rough foul. Livio Marinelli stops the game and makes a call. It's a free kick to Sassuolo, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
40' The game is interrupted now, Denzel Dumfries (Inter) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
40' Denzel Dumfries plays a lovely pass into Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly over the crossbar.
38' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
37' The ball is cleared after Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Now Sassuolo have a corner.
36' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
33' Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
31' Livio Marinelli shows a yellow card to Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) for his blatant foul.
31' Total attempts – 7:2. 2:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
29' CHANCE! Marcus Thuram (Inter) fires just wide of the left post from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Denzel Dumfries.
25' Unlucky! Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) hits a thunderous volley on the edge of the box that just flies over the bar.
24' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) attempts to find Andrea Pinamonti, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
23' Manuel Akanji (Inter) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Livio Marinelli signals.
22' Nicolo Barella (Inter) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar.

19' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies a whisker wide of the left post. That would have been a great goal!
19' Marcus Thuram (Inter) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
17' Ball possession – 58:42.

14' 1 - 0 Goal! Petar Sucic plays in Federico Dimarco (Inter), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom left corner 1:0.
14' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
13' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
12' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter).
12' Nicolo Barella (Inter) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee signals a corner kick to Inter.

11' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar.
10' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.

9' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Josep Martinez pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
8' A good run and leap by Carlos Augusto (Inter) to meet the corner from Hakan Calhanoglu ends in nothing, as the close-range header flies a mile wide of the left post.
8' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

7' Carlos Augusto (Inter) weaves through the defence with ease and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score with his strike towards the bottom right corner as Arijanet Muric produces a good save.
3' Carlos Augusto (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but Arijanet Muric comes off his line to gather the ball.
3' A cross is whipped into the box by Petar Sucic (Inter) and Marcus Thuram controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention.
2' Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
1' Livio Marinelli blows his whistle and signals a foul after Federico Dimarco (Inter) brought his opponent down.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Sassuolo will kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Livio Marinelli is introduced as the referee for today's match.
